examples.text: bahū devā manussā ca, maṅgalāni acintayuṃ, ākaṅkhamānā sotthānaṃ, brūhi maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.
kassako paṭijānāsi, na ca passāma te kasiṃ, kasiṃ no pucchito brūhi, yathā jānemu te kasiṃ.

idh'āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu paṭisallān'ārāmo hoti paṭisallānarato, ajjhattaṃ cetosamatham'anuyutto anirākatajjhāno, vipassanāya samannāgato, brūhetā suññ'āgārānaṃ. evarūpena kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti.
te imaṃ kāyaṃ balaṃ gāhenti nāma, brūhenti nāma, medenti nāmā'ti.

49111.commentary: (VINa) yakārena vā bhakārena vā'ti yakārabhakāre yojetvā yo akkoso.

examples.text: hīno nāma akkoso, oṭṭho'si, meṇḍo'si, goṇo'si, gadrabho'si, tiracchānagato'si, nerayiko'si, n'atthi tuyhaṃ sugati, duggati y'eva tuyhaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā'ti, yakārena vā bhakārena vā, kāṭakoṭacikāya vā, eso hīno nāma akkoso.

49112.commentary: (SNPa) bhakuṭiṃ vinayitvānā'ti yaṃ ekacce dubbuddhino yācakaṃ disvā bhakuṭiṃ karonti, taṃ vinayitvā, pasannamukhā hutvā'ti attho. (JAa) bhakuṭiṃ katvā'ti kodhavasena valivisamaṃ nalāṭaṃ katvā.

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, vedehikā gahapatānī kāḷiṃ dāsiṃ etadavoca, he je kāḷī'ti. kiṃ, ayye'ti? kiṃ, je, divā uṭṭhāsī'ti? na khv'ayye, kiñcī'ti. no vata re kiñci, pāpi dāsi, divā uṭṭhāsī'ti kupitā anattamanā bhakuṭiṃ akāsi.
yadā maṃ bhakuṭiṃ katvā, rājaputtī udikkhati, āḷāriko tadā homi, rañño maddass'antepure.

saññā nu kho, bhante, purisassa attā, udāhu aññā saññā añño attā'ti? kaṃ pana tvaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, attānaṃ paccesī'ti? oḷārikaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, attānaṃ paccemi rūpiṃ cātumahābhūtikaṃ kabaḷīkār'āhārabhakkhan'ti.
susukhaṃ vata jīvāma, yesaṃ no n'atthi kiñcanaṃ, pītibhakkhā bhavissāma, devā ābhassarā yathā.
n'āhaṃ addakkhiṃ sambuddhaṃ, na'pi saddaṃ suṇom'ahaṃ, mama bhakkhaṃ gavesanto, āhiṇḍāmi vane ahaṃ.
evam'eva ahaṃ kāḷa, bhutvā bhakkhaṃ ras'uttamaṃ, aladdhā mānusaṃ maṃsaṃ, maññe hissāmi jīvitaṃ.

49120.commentary: (JAa) bhakkhayitvā'ti amma ete ettakā nūna mama maṃsaṃ khāditvā ajarā bhavissanti.

examples.text: so varaṃ varaṃ migasaṃghe vadhitvā mudumaṃsāni mudumaṃsāni bhakkhayitvā tam'eva āsayaṃ ajjhupeyyan'ti.
soṇā dhaṅkā siṅgālā ca, ye c'aññe santi dāṭhino, ajarā nūna hessanti, bhakkhayitvā pabhāvatiṃ.
addasā kho, bhaggava, sunakkhatto licchaviputto acelaṃ korakkhattiyaṃ kukkuravatikaṃ catukkuṇḍikaṃ chamānikiṇṇaṃ bhakkhasaṃ mukhen'eva khādantaṃ mukhen'eva bhuñjantaṃ.
ye ca tasmiṃ satthe'pi ahesuṃ manussā vā pasū vā, tesañ'ca aṭṭhikān'eva addasaṃsu tena yakkhena amanussena bhakkhitānaṃ.

iti imasmiṃ kāye vividhā ābādhā uppajjanti, seyyath'idaṃ… pakkhandikā sūlā visūcikā kuṭṭhaṃ gaṇḍo kilāso soso apamāro daddu kaṇḍu kacchu nakhasā vitacchikā lohitaṃ pittaṃ madhumeho aṃsā piḷakā bhagandalā

bhagavant + ā

seyyathā'pi, bhante, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī'ti. evam'evaṃ bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.

49134.meaning1: in the Sublime One; in the Blessed One; in the Fortunate One; in the Auspicious One
49134.construction:

examples.text: evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ, bhante, bhagavati, pahoti bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathā ahaṃ cevimaṃ govataṃ pajaheyyaṃ, ayañ'c'eva acelo seniyo kukkuravatiko taṃ kukkuravataṃ pajaheyyā'ti.

atha kho te bhikkhū tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ n'eva abhinandiṃsu nappaṭikkosiṃsu, anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamiṃsu, bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmā'ti.
atha kho tā devatā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekam'antaṃ ṭhitā kho ekā devatā bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi

bhagavant + to

atha kho kasibhāradvājo brāhmaṇo mahatiyā kaṃsapātiyā pāyāsaṃ vaḍḍhetvā bhagavato upanāmesi, bhuñjatu bhavaṃ gotamo pāyasaṃ.

bhagavant + to

idam'avoca bhagavā. attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun'ti.

etassa bhagavā kālo, etassa sugata kālo, yaṃ bhagavā dhammaṃ deseyya. bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī'ti.

examples.text: anejaṃ mūladassāviṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, kiṃ nissitā isayo manujā, khattiyā brāhmaṇā devatānaṃ, yaññam'akappayiṃsu puthū'dha loke, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.
bhagavaṃmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā bhagavaṃnettikā bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā. sādhu vata, bhante, bhagavantaṃ'y'eva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho. bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī'ti.

49141.commentary: (DNt) bhagavato rūpaṃ sabhāvo viya rūpam'assā'ti bhagavantarūpo, bhagavā viya ek'antapaṇḍito'ti attho.

examples.text: yathā kathaṃ pana te, mahārāja, byākariṃsu, sace te agaru bhāsassū'ti. na kho me, bhante, garu, yatth'assa bhagavā nisinno, bhagavantarūpo vā'ti. tena hi, mahārāja, bhāsassū'ti.

examples.text: ko vedanāya assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇan'ti? bhagavaṃmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā bhagavan'nettikā bhagavam'paṭisaraṇā. sādhu, bhante, bhagavantaññ'eva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho.

examples.text: etha tumhe, bhikkhave, mātumattīsu mātucittaṃ upaṭṭhapetha, bhaginimattīsu bhaginicittaṃ upaṭṭhapetha, dhītumattīsu dhītucittaṃ upaṭṭhapethā'ti.

dīgharattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, pitumaraṇaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ… bhātumaraṇaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ… bhaginimaraṇaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ… puttamaraṇaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ… dhītumaraṇaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ… ñātibyasanaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ… bhogabyasanaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ.
yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā mātāpiturakkhitā bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sasāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi
na kho mayaṃ, bhaginī, accharānaṃ hetu brahmacariyaṃ carāmā'ti. bhaginivādena no ayyaputto raṭṭhapālo samudācaratī'ti tā tatth'eva mucchitā papatiṃsu.

mātā'pi puttena vivadati, putto'pi mātarā vivadati, pitā'pi puttena vivadati, putto'pi pitarā vivadati, bhātā'pi bhātarā vivadati, bhātā'pi bhaginiyā vivadati, bhaginī'pi bhātarā vivadati, sahāyo'pi sahāyena vivadati.

bhūtapubb'āhaṃ, pāpima, dūsī nāma māro ahosiṃ, tassa me kāḷī nāma bhaginī. tassā tvaṃ putto. so me tvaṃ bhāgineyyo ahosi. tena kho pana, pāpima, samayena kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.
evam'etaṃ bhaginiyo evam'etaṃ bhaginiyo!
muṭṭhīhi'pi yujjhanti, raṅgamajjhe'pi saṅghāṭiṃ pattharitvā naccakiṃ evaṃ vadanti, idha, bhagini, naccassū'ti, nalāṭikam'pi denti, vividham'pi anācāraṃ ācaranti.

49159.commentary: (APt) bharatī'ti bhagu, bhaṃ vānakkhattaṃ gacchati jānātī'ti bhagu, u.

gahakāraka diṭṭho'si, puna gehaṃ na kāhasi, sabbā te phāsukā bhaggā, gahakūṭaṃ visaṅkhataṃ, visaṅkhāragataṃ cittaṃ, taṇhānaṃ khayam'ajjhagā.

atha kho bhagavato etadahosi, atippago kho tāva anupiyāyaṃ piṇḍāya carituṃ. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ yena bhaggavagottassa paribbājakassa ārāmo, yena bhaggavagotto paribbājako ten'upasaṅkameyyan'ti.

49167.commentary: (MNa) bhaggesū'ti evaṃnāmake janapade, vacan'attho pan'ettha vutt'ānusāren'eva veditabbo.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bhaggesu viharati susumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahāmoggallāno magadhesu kallavāḷaputtagāme pacalāyamāno nisinno hoti.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhaggesu viharati susumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye.
sare hatthehi bhañjitvā, katvāna kuṭim'acchisaṃ, tena me sarabhaṅgo'ti, nāmaṃ sammutiyā ahu.

49169.meaning1: breaking up; falling apart; dissolution; disintegration (of)

examples.text: attanā'pi tasmiṃ sare sārajjati, pare'pi tasmiṃ sare sārajjanti, gahapatikā'pi ujjhāyanti, yath'eva mayaṃ gāyāma, evam'evaṃ kho samaṇā sakyaputtiyā gāyantī'ti, sarakuttim'pi nikāmayamānassa samādhissa bhaṅgo hoti, pacchimā janatā diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjati.

49170.meaning1: hempen; made of hemp; (comm) mixed cloth
49170.commentary: (VINa) bhaṅgan'ti pāṭekkaṃ vākasuttam'evā'ti eke. etehi pañcahi missetvā katasuttaṃ pana bhaṅgan'ti veditabbaṃ.

channaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataran'ti khomaṃ, kappāsikaṃ, koseyyaṃ, kambalaṃ, sāṇaṃ, bhaṅgan'ti imesaṃ channaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ.

49176.meaning2: to be nourished or brought up

49177.commentary: (JAa) bhaccā'ti mātā ca pitā ca sesabandhū ca bharitabbā nāma.

examples.text: bhuttā bhogā bhatā bhaccā, vitiṇṇā āpadāsu me, uddhaggā dakkhiṇā dinnā, atho pañcabalī katā, upaṭṭhitā sīlavanto, saññatā brahmacārayo.
nidhīnaṃ'va pavattāraṃ, yaṃ passe vajjadassinaṃ, niggayhavādiṃ medhāviṃ, tādisaṃ paṇḍitaṃ bhaje, tādisaṃ bhajamānassa, seyyo hoti na pāpiyo.
nihīyati puriso nihīnasevī, na ca hāyetha kadāci tulyasevī, seṭṭham'upanamaṃ udeti khippaṃ, tasmā attano uttariṃ bhajethā'ti.
saddho sīlena sampanno, yasobhogasamappito, yaṃ yaṃ padesaṃ bhajati, tattha tatth'eva pūjito.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivittaṃ sen'āsanaṃ bhajati
ye naṃ dadanti saddhāya, vippasannena cetasā, tam'eva annaṃ bhajati, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca.

49181.meaning1: devotes oneself; applies oneself; gives oneself (to)

examples.text: niddaṃ na bahulīkareyya, jāgariyaṃ bhajeyya ātāpī, tandiṃ māyaṃ hassaṃ khiḍḍaṃ, methunaṃ vippajahe savibhūsaṃ.

bhikkhuno vijigucchato, bhajato rittam'āsanaṃ, rukkhamūlaṃ susānaṃ vā, pabbatānaṃ guhāsu vā.
nidhīnaṃ'va pavattāraṃ, yaṃ passe vajjadassinaṃ, niggayhavādiṃ medhāviṃ, tādisaṃ paṇḍitaṃ bhaje, tādisaṃ bhajamānassa, seyyo hoti na pāpiyo.
kalyāṇamittatā muninā, lokaṃ ādissa vaṇṇitā, kalyāṇamitte bhajamāno, api bālo paṇḍito assa.

49192.meaning2: having associated with, having kept company

49193.grammar: opt, reflx 3rd sg of bhajeyya, trans (+acc)

examples.text: nihīyati puriso nihīnasevī, na ca hāyetha kadāci tulyasevī, seṭṭham'upanamaṃ udeti khippaṃ, tasmā attano uttariṃ bhajethā'ti.
tasmā hi dhīrañ'ca paññañ'ca bahussutañ'ca, dhorayhasīlaṃ vatavantam'ariyaṃ, taṃ tādisaṃ sappurisaṃ sumedhaṃ, bhajetha nakkhattapathaṃ'va candimā.
nidhīnaṃ'va pavattāraṃ, yaṃ passe vajjadassinaṃ, niggayhavādiṃ medhāviṃ, tādisaṃ paṇḍitaṃ bhaje, tādisaṃ bhajamānassa, seyyo hoti na pāpiyo.
